description: Enumerate EVERY Zillow listing matching the filters inside a location (resolved like zillow_search_properties) or an explicit bounding box, without silent truncation. Splits the area into map tiles and recursively quarters any tile whose Zillow-reported total exceeds what one query can return, dedupes by zpid and re-applies the numeric filters (drift guard). Returns a completeness summary (requests, tiles, unique listings, tiles still truncated at max depth, drift warnings such as Zillow ignoring the price filter or the viewport) plus the listings, or writes the listings to `output_path` as JSON for large areas (inside the output directory: ZILLOW_OUTPUT_DIR, default ~/Downloads/zillow-mcp). Sequential requests with a delay, paced by the same per-host requests-per-minute throttle as `zillow_bulk_get`; if Zillow's bot-wall blocks a request the sweep stops and returns `{ blocked: true, retry_after_s }` with what it had. Read-only against Zillow; the only write is the optional local output file.

bounds.description: Optional box to sweep; defaults to the resolved region's map bounds.

delay_ms.description: Pause before every Zillow request, including each page within a tile (default 1200).

location.description: City / ZIP / county used to resolve the region (e.g. "King County, WA").

max_requests.description: Hard request budget (default 150), counting the resolve call and every page; the sweep stops mid-tile rather than exceed it.

output_path.description: Optional NEW .json file to write the full results (and per-tile counts) to: a file name (e.g. "san-jose.json") written into the output directory (ZILLOW_OUTPUT_DIR, default ~/Downloads/zillow-mcp), or an absolute path inside it. Paths outside that directory are refused, and an existing file is never overwritten. Omit to get the results inline; use a file for large areas so the listings stay out of the conversation.

tile_cap.description: Treat a tile as complete only if its total is at most this (default 400).

name: zillow_sweep_area
title: Exhaustively sweep a Zillow search area
